title: HUD Viewport  desk frame or window, wires BACK with p pointers

concept.insight: every entity on the HUD IS a viewport. a viewport becomes a desk frame or a window. it wires BACK to the HUD with p pointers. the name is renameable  centrality/origin/axis/function are the organizational primitives, not the labels.
concept.circuit: HUD entity ? desk frame ? window (RustDesk/browser) ? p pointer back to HUD ? loop
concept.renameable: the structure IS the pointer. change the label, the pointer persists. change the frame, the viewport persists.
concept.pi_pointer: each viewport carries a p address: (carry, remainder). carry = which circle. remainder = where on that circle. irrational = never exactly repeats.
